mapper.select:
WITH selected_area AS ( SELECT area_code, sido_code, sigungu_code, eupmyeondong_code, name, full_name, COALESCE(#{areaLevel}, level) AS selected_level FROM ( SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.area_code = #{areaCode} THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{areaCode} THEN 1 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 5) THEN 2 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{areaCode} THEN 3 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 8) THEN 4 ELSE 9 END AS match_priority FROM public.sd_area_code c WHERE c.area_code = #{areaCode} OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{areaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 5) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{areaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 8) ) ORDER BY match_priority, c.area_code LIMIT 1 ) matched_area LIMIT 1 ), scope_candidates AS ( SELECT c.area_code, 1 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.sigungu_code || '00000' AS area_code, 2 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND c.sigungu_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT s.area_code, 1 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIGUNGU'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.sigungu_code || '00000' AS area_code, 2 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIGUNGU' AND s.sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND s.sigungu_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code
UNION ALL
SELECT s.area_code, 1 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.eupmyeondong_code || '00' AS area_code, 2 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND s.eupmyeondong_code IS NOT NULL AND s.eupmyeondong_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT s.area_code, 1 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 2 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code = s.eupmyeondong_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.eupmyeondong_code || '00' AS area_code, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code = s.eupmyeondong_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code IS NOT NULL AND c.eupmyeondong_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 4 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code ), available_priority AS ( SELECT MIN(sc.priority) AS priority FROM scope_candidates sc JOIN public.sd_area_population p ON p.area_code = sc.area_code WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.base_date = #{baseDate}
AND p.hour = #{hour}
), filtered_population AS ( SELECT p.* FROM public.sd_area_population p JOIN scope_candidates sc ON sc.area_code = p.area_code JOIN available_priority ap ON ap.priority = sc.priority WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.base_date = #{baseDate}
AND p.hour = #{hour}
), latest_population AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.area_code) p.* FROM filtered_population p ORDER BY p.area_code, p.base_date DESC, p.hour DESC, p.population_id DESC ) SELECT MIN(p.population_id) AS population_id, s.area_code, s.name AS area_name, s.full_name, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.source_code, ',') AS source_code, MAX(p.base_date) AS base_date, MAX(p.hour) AS hour, SUM(p.total_population) AS total_population, SUM(p.male_population) AS male_population, SUM(p.female_population) AS female_population, SUM(p.male_0_9) AS male0To9, SUM(p.male_10_14) AS male10To14, SUM(p.male_15_19) AS male15To19, SUM(p.male_20_24) AS male20To24, SUM(p.male_25_29) AS male25To29, SUM(p.male_30_34) AS male30To34, SUM(p.male_35_39) AS male35To39, SUM(p.male_40_44) AS male40To44, SUM(p.male_45_49) AS male45To49, SUM(p.male_50_54) AS male50To54, SUM(p.male_55_59) AS male55To59, SUM(p.male_60_64) AS male60To64, SUM(p.male_65_69) AS male65To69, SUM(p.male_70_74) AS male70To74, SUM(p.female_0_9) AS female0To9, SUM(p.female_10_14) AS female10To14, SUM(p.female_15_19) AS female15To19, SUM(p.female_20_24) AS female20To24, SUM(p.female_25_29) AS female25To29, SUM(p.female_30_34) AS female30To34, SUM(p.female_35_39) AS female35To39, SUM(p.female_40_44) AS female40To44, SUM(p.female_45_49) AS female45To49, SUM(p.female_50_54) AS female50To54, SUM(p.female_55_59) AS female55To59, SUM(p.female_60_64) AS female60To64, SUM(p.female_65_69) AS female65To69, SUM(p.female_70_74) AS female70To74, MAX(CAST(p.metadata AS varchar)) AS metadata, MAX(p.created_at) AS created_at, MAX(p.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM latest_population p CROSS JOIN selected_area s GROUP BY s.area_code, s.name, s.full_name
